limitations: Entry contexts are logical candidates, including impossible world states; witness flags are assumptions, not physical reachability proof.
Numeric scores start at authored defaults. Numeric-gated conversations mark the report incomplete.
Phrase matches are review warnings, not semantic equivalence or automatic rewrite decisions. Short acknowledgements and intentional replays of the same authored line are excluded.
Coverage is within conversations and authored cutscene sequences, not arbitrary ordering of separate world interactions. Older repeats outside the three-line window are not checked.
